changelog: - "My feedback" (`/account/feedback`) says how far along a person's reports are — "X of N completed, Y waiting", with "will not be changed" counted on its own — and filters the list by that outcome (All / Waiting / Completed / Will not be changed, kept in `?status=`). The rule is `src/lib/myFeedbackFilter.ts`; the list stays the caller's own reports only (#3929).

en: "My feedback" now shows how many of your reports are completed and how many are waiting, and you can filter by status.
tr: "Gönderdiğim geri bildirimler" artık kaç bildiriminin tamamlandığını ve kaçının beklediğini gösteriyor; duruma göre süzebilirsin.
de: „Meine Rückmeldungen“ zeigt jetzt, wie viele deiner Meldungen erledigt und wie viele offen sind, und lässt sich nach Status filtern.
